value.verdict: ep00, ep01 and ep02 are close to ready, but four places drop to a blank frame. In ep01 at 0:19.5, and in ep02 at 0:24.2, 0:28.0 and 5:00.5, the picture cuts to empty paper for about 0.3 to 0.7 s between parts of the episode (intro, title card, body, outro). Those are the only must findings. Elsewhere, ep00 at 6.8 to 7.0 s, ep01 at 23.2 s and 6:42.0, and ep02 at 3.2 s cross-fade correctly. All three episodes also fade to an empty frame for about 0.7 s before the end card (should). The rest is should-level: an empty stage in ep02 at 1:20.0 to 1:24.3, beats that hold too briefly (ep02 at 4:20 and 0:50.5, ep01 at 3:31), and grey solid frames used for things that are neither unread nor unfound (ep00 at 2:42, ep01 at 3:09). That grey use is inconsistent with ep04's last-round rule that grey solid is only for unread or not-found material. All 16 picture-checkable fixes listed under 成片审阅后的改动 for ep00, ep01 and ep02 landed. The intros, outros and end cards are correct: the series map highlights the right number on the right words, each 下一集 line matches the next episode's title, and the end cards are one column in ep00 and two columns in ep01 and ep02, with no clipping and no scrolling. Chapter labels agree with the narration at every cut. I saw no cropped text that stays on screen, no overlapping text, and no dashed line used against the legend: 本系列的读法 is dashed everywhere it appears, and 书评转述 and 可读书页中未见 are grey solid. The ep02 fix that moves the 'Qureshi 把这本书往外用' subtitle about 1 s earlier cannot be checked in pictures. In the vtt that cue now starts at 4:11.63, about 1.3 s before the speech engine's word time for 把这本书往外用. I extracted about 260 dense frames.

value.verdict: Most of the shared furniture matches across all six episodes: the ident, the title card (same position and sub-line pattern), the intro 'this episode / last episode' beat (the switch lands 0.3–0.5 s after the word in every episode), the chapter label, the y=830 next-episode line, the end-card headings, the chapter titles (inventories = episode READMEs = compilation list, compilation times 0:03/5:16/11:39/16:16/21:47/27:08 match), edition notation 第 1 版/第 2 版, and the label 试点 · 8 到 12 周. Not yet consistent: the outro handoff and outro map, quote-card furniture, end-card source formatting, and several typography and legend details. Four issues rate must: (1) blank-paper frames at the body→outro cut in ep02, ep03 and ep05, plus one inside ep05; (2) the outro highlight lands on the next episode 1.4–1.7 s before the narration names it in ep01 and ep03; (3) ep03's Lonsdale legend pairs the dashed sample with '原文未提'; (4) ep01's push-in slices dimmed text at the frame edge for about 4 s. Method note for whoever reads the 2 s contact sheets: each labelled frame shows roughly label + 0.6–1 s. Example: ep05/sheet-09 '5:24.0' shows the empty paper that 0.25 s frames put at 5:24.75–5:25.0. Every time below comes from 0.25 s dense sheets (review-b/xep/) or from the screen-text inventories. Nothing under the project directory was edited.

findings.observation: Each episode hands over from the last body scene to the outro map in a different way. In three of them the frame goes fully blank, with neither content nor chapter label. ep02 shows empty paper for about 0.5 s and ep03 for about 0.3 s. ep05 is the worst: a hard cut out of the 'FDE（驻客户现场的工程师）的要务' diagram, about 0.6 s of empty paper, then the map builds column by column. ep05 has a second hard cut to empty paper (chapter label only) at the chapter change from '“需要知道”原则' to '回到驻场'. The other three each do it differently again: ep01 cross-fades, so the map words sit on top of the 'FDE 进门之后的头几步' boxes for about 0.3 s at 06:42.0; ep04 hard-cuts straight to the map (05:34.0→05:34.25); ep00's map is the body's own object, so there is no cut. acceptance.md records that ep00 was fixed to cross-fade and 'no longer flash blank'; the other episodes did not get the same fix.

value.verdict: ep03, ep04 and ep05 are close to ready. I found one must: the ep03 end card still scrolls in its last 3 s, and the "出处" header and the first source lines of both columns fade out under the top mask. Every acceptance bullet I could check in pictures landed. Two landed only in part: in ep03 the "无" in Mabrey's 权力 row fills 2.5 s after the quote, and in ep04 the three closing cards are preceded by about 2 s of an empty dashed frame. The rest are should/could items: composition lapses (stage mostly empty for 2–8 s at ep05 "需要知道" and the S-1 beat, and the ep04 closing card), a camera push that crops the fading table in ep04, and grey solid used for meanings outside the legend in ep03 and ep05. Intros (series map focus moves from the previous episode to this one on "这一集/最后一集") and outros (ep03 → 04 把错误摆上桌面, ep04 → 05 没有送到的情报, ep05 map with no 下一集) are correct in all three. End cards for ep04 and ep05 are static and unclipped. Timing caveat for anyone reading the 2-s contact sheets: each frame shows content from about 0.6–1 s after its label (ffmpeg fps rounding). I timed all findings below from 0.1–0.5 s dense frames or the screen-text inventory. I also ran a darkest-pixel pass at 10 fps (no frames written). It shows 0.3–0.6 s dips to near-empty paper at most page boundaries in all three episodes. That looks like the standard page transition, so I did not report them one by one. The start node 一件事 already carries a grey border in the same chain. The gate still reads as a stated step, not as 'not read or not found'. The text stays fully legible and Allen's own words are what is lit. 15 s later the Lonsdale row uses the grey boxes with an explicit 未提 label, which carries the 'not found' meaning in words. No viewer would confuse the two, so this is not a legend breach.

The legend '原文未提 · 本系列的读法' with a dashed sample is coherent with the series legend (review-b/ep03-lons/sheet-01.png, 3:42 to 3:44). The ep04 and ep05 legends '本系列的读法 · 并置对照' label a dashed container around two side-by-side columns (ep04 4:53, ep05 5:43), which is a different structure. The legend lands with 这两个前提他都没提 at about 3:42.5 and holds about 2.5 s to the chapter cut at 3:45, which is enough for 11 characters; the 未提 boxes are visible from 3:40.
